text:
alex: FYI customers are reporting quota mis-attribution after the last console header change. they set a premium plan in the UI but billing shows default bucket. :confused:
priya: can you drop an example request? is the header making it to the API?
sam: i captured one from a customer edge: request leaves as `X-Redwood-Plan: premium` but our internal proxy forwards it as `x-redwood-plan`. console matcher currently does exact-case match.
maria: sigh. lots of proxies lowercase headers. we should avoid case-sensitive header matches.
alex: agree. we need a low-risk path: server tolerant matching + SDK normalization.
priya: proposal: server accepts either `x-redwood-plan` OR shorthand `x-rw-plan`. add a feature flag `plan_header_aliasing` for rollout.
sam: SDK work: py/go/ts should set `x-rw-plan` header canonical name before sending. non-breaking. add telemetry ping `plan_header_normalized` with opt-out.
maria: TS details: node-fetch preserves case but some frameworks don't. add a small util in all clients: `normalizePlanHeader(headers)`
priya: infra: can we enable flag as 5% canary? infra-sre: yes canary at 15:30 UTC, will route 5% of orgs through alias logic.
alex: tests: unit for header normalization, integ e2e via curl, and a small console matcher unit to accept both variants.
sam: quick python snippet:```py
# before sending
headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in headers.items()}
if 'x-redwood-plan' in headers:
    headers['x-rw-plan'] = headers['x-redwood-plan']
```
maria: TS shim:```ts
const h = new Headers(orig);
const plan = h.get('x-redwood-plan') || h.get('x-rw-plan');
if (plan) h.set('x-rw-plan', plan);
```
priya: console change will be tiny: matcher will treat header names case-insensitively and consider alias. put behind `plan_header_aliasing` flag.
devex-bot: drafting changelog blurb and SDK release notes (DOC-501).
infra-sre: deployed canary at 15:31 UTC. monitoring logs and metric streams.
alex: add a regression alert: if quota attribution delta > 0.5% for any org during canary, rollback.
maria: pushing SDK branches with normalization and tests, PRs in flight.
sam: can we also instrument how many requests came from customers using custom proxies (via user-agent?) might be noisy.
priya: follow-up: add telemetry labelled `plan_header_source` = [sdk-normalized, direct, unknown] so we can roll forward with confidence.
infra-sre: watch dashboard updated: https://console.redwood.run/dashboards/plan-attr-canary
devex-bot: console tile for canary live.
alex: timeline: today SDK PRs + tests. tomorrow enable canary for 24h. then evaluate and flip flag if stable.
priya: thanks all, i'll coordinate doc updates and owner handoffs.
maria: noted, i'll add migration notes and sample code to quickstart.
alex: tagging owners: @priya (platform), @maria (sdks), @infra-sre (deploy). reconvene after 24h. :thumbsup:
